title.value: Optimal Extragradient-Based Algorithms for Stochastic Variational Inequalities with Separable Structure
title.justification: The title provides a direct description of the main subject of the research paper, focusing on the development of "Optimal Extragradient-Based Algorithms" for a specific problem touching upon stochastic variational inequalities that have a "Separable Structure."
title.quote: Optimal Extragradient-Based Algorithms for Stochastic Variational Inequalities with Separable Structure Huizhuo Yuan⇧ Chris Junchi Li† Gauthier Gidel‡ Michael I. Jordan†,⇤ Quanquan Gu⇧ Simon S. Du?

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development and analysis of a novel algorithm, the stochastic accelerated gradient-extragradient (AG-EG), designed to improve the efficiency of solving stochastic monotone variational inequalities with a separable structure. This algorithm specifically addresses challenges in problems such as strongly monotone variational inequalities and bilinearly coupled strongly-convex-strongly-concave saddle-point problems, which have applications in machine learning such as reinforcement learning and GANs. The paper also presents the theoretical convergence rates of the proposed algorithm.

primary_category.quote: We consider the problem of solving stochastic monotone variational inequalities with a separable structure using a stochastic first-order oracle. Building on standard extragradient for variational inequalities we propose a novel algorithm—stochastic accelerated gradient-extragradient (AG-EG).
